senses.definition: n.[f.] (cf. Sta§ 310 c) c. יַד thumb, c. רֶגֶל great toe (Arabic إِبْهَامٌ & (vulg.) بَاهِمٌ, بِهَامٌ )—בּ׳ only cstr. Ex 29:20(×2) + 12 times; pl. cstr. בְּהֹנוֹת Ju 1:6, 7 (from sg. [בְּהוֹן] as always Cod. Sam. for MT בֹּהֶן);—thumb (יָדָם) בּ׳ יָדוֹ, & great toe (רַגְלָם) בּ׳ רַגְלוֹ (always named together) Ex 29:20(×2) Lv 8:23(×2), 24(×2); 14:14(×2), 17(×2), 25(×2), 28(×2); בְּהֹנוֹת י׳ וְר׳ Ju 1:6, 7.
